name: decode_rle_planar_image

name: unpack_rle_interleaved_planes
description: Unpacks a run-length stream into 40-byte rows, stepping between plane offsets as each row group completes and stopping when the outer counter runs out. A non-negative count copies literal bytes, while a negative count repeats a single byte.

name: copy_8000_words_from_table

name: copy_values_after_sentinel_marker
description: Scans two word tables for a sentinel value of 384, then copies sixteen 16-bit values from a source pointer into both tables after their sentinels, advancing through both tables together.

name: clear_and_unpack_rle_planes
description: Zeroes an 8000-byte destination block and then decodes run-length data into it one 40-byte row at a time across four plane blocks. A marker byte of all ones skips an entire plane block.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1080A
name: unpack_rle_planes_skip_marker
description: Decodes run-length data into 40-byte-wide rows across four plane blocks. A marker byte of all ones skips an entire plane block, a zero count repeats one value, and a non-negative count copies literal bytes.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1081E
name: decode_rle_strided_plane_rows
description: Decodes run-length data into destination rows whose step between bytes is a variable stride, copying literal runs and repeating single bytes. A marker byte of all ones skips a whole plane block.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:10846
name: fill_strided_runs_from_stream
description: Decodes strided run-length records into a destination: a zero-count record repeats one value across the stride, while other records copy literal bytes, and rows and planes advance as the counters run out.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1085C
name: decode_skip_literal_repeat_stream
description: Decodes a strided byte stream where positive codes advance the destination by a value from a lookup table, negative codes copy literal bytes, and a zero code repeats the following byte. A marker of all ones skips a plane block.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:10876
name: decode_rle_planes_until_marker
description: Advances through blocks of 8000 bytes, decoding run-length rows of 40 bytes into each block until a marker byte of all ones ends that block's data.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:10A10
name: setup_table_then_enable_dma
description: Initialises a table with constant values, runs a retry loop of register-access calls until a status word reads zero, then writes a fixed sequence of values to the DMA control register.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:10A8C
name: poll_status_word_until_clear
description: Repeatedly exchanges a status value with hardware until a read returns zero, returning minus one on a failed check. After the loop it issues a fixed sequence of register writes and returns zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:10AD8
name: wait_nonzero_status_then_write
description: Loops reading a status word until one register exchange returns non-zero, returning minus one on an error condition, then issues a fixed sequence of register writes and returns zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:10B38
name: copy_fields_then_scan_entries
description: Copies two word fields within a structure to other offsets in the same structure and stores a third word in a global. key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:10C7E
name: adjust_global_on_index_match
description: Calls a sub-routine, and if its result is zero and an input word matches a global index, writes a value from a structure reduced by four into a global. It then calls another sub-routine when a structure field is negative.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:10CBE
name: initialize_first_free_slot
description: Finds the first unused entry in a global array of 52-byte records, marks it used, and fills its fields from input values and a lookup table. It then calls a sub-routine with the record.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:10D6A
name: dispatch_indirect_by_index
description: Reads an index from a global variable and jumps indirectly to the routine whose offset is stored in a table at that index. It does no other work.

name: copy_three_blocks_into_globals
description: Copies consecutive byte blocks into a global area from fixed source areas, copies two words under a flag condition, then clears one global word and copies another.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:10E90
name: filter_entries_into_two_lists
description: Walks a set of 314-byte records and, for each, builds two lists of word pairs from global table entries whose flag byte is positive. It stores each list's count in the record and clears one of its words.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:10F1A
name: reset_globals_and_init_flags
description: Clears several global words and a byte range, then, if a mode flag is zero, sets initial flag values and a table pointer. It selects two adjustment values from a global and writes a set of constants into global variables.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:11044
name: store_modular_offset_result
description: Calls two sub-routines, then stores into a global the register value taken modulo five, multiplied by 727, plus a second register value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:11078
name: or_accumulate_words_into_tables
description: Optionally selects a base pointer from a global, then for a counter derived from a global value divided by five ORs eight 32-bit words from a source table into two destination tables. The source advances by 250 bytes per pass.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:110CC
name: reset_counters_and_sync_state
description: Polls two global values for up to nine passes, clears a counter, and conditionally calls a sub-routine when a timer is at or below a threshold. It then increments a counter, copies two words into two others, and calls another routine.

name: clamp_two_globals_to_range
description: Clamps two global values into the range zero to 56, setting values below zero to zero and values above 55 to 56.

name: clamp_two_globals_to_range
description: Clamps two global values into the range zero to 56, setting values below zero to zero and values above 55 to 56.

name: swap_two_entries
description: Swaps eight bytes and two 16-bit fields between two records selected by an input index and the current global index. It exchanges a table value when it is neither six nor eight, then stores the new index in a global.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:11252
name: invoke_two_subroutines_only
description: The decompiled body is unavailable, so only its relationships are known: it calls two other routines and is called by two. Its thirty instructions are not interpreted further.

name: invoke_three_subroutines_only
description: The decompiled body is unavailable, so only its relationships are known: it calls three other routines and is entered from a data pointer and another routine. Its twenty-two instructions are not interpreted further.

name: decrement_counter_and_clear_flags
description: Decrements a per-slot counter in a global table by two, applies a further adjustment and a sub-routine call when a flag bit is set, and clears several status bytes in the record depending on a sub-routine's result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12518
name: move_link_into_table_slot
description: Moves a link value from one record into a table slot, updates the neighbouring link with the offset difference between records, increments a table byte, and returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1256E
name: relink_entry_when_key_changes
description: Writes two new values into a record and, if they differ from the old key, unlinks the record from its old list and links it at the head of the list for the new key, returning one. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:125A0
name: insert_entry_at_list_head
description: Clears a link field in a record and pushes the record onto the head of a list selected by a key computed from two record bytes. The previous head is linked behind it.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:125DA
name: unlink_node_from_list
description: Removes a record from the singly linked list whose head is selected by a key from the record. It updates either the head or the predecessor's link, clears the record's own link, and returns its D0 input unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:128FA
name: merge_source_record_into_target
description: Copies selected fields from a source record into a target when flags allow, merges the source flag byte into the target, and keeps the larger of two level bytes. It adds the source's 32-bit total to the target's and then clears those source fields.

name: accumulate_entry_and_set_state
description: Adds a computed amount to a per-slot total in a global table and increments a counter, then subtracts that amount from another total, clamping at zero. It then sets state bytes in the record, branching on flag bits and a type byte, and calls sub-routines.

name: reset_entity_state
description: Calls a sub-routine, calls another when a mode field equals two, then clears a 16-bit field and sets a state byte to a fixed value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12A38
name: set_state_fields_and_call
description: Unless either of two records has type four, which triggers two sub-routine calls instead, it writes a pair of state bytes and a 16-bit field chosen by an index byte, then calls a sub-routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12A58
name: call_pair_or_set_state
description: When the first record has type four it calls two sub-routines. Otherwise it writes state bytes and a 16-bit field chosen by an index byte, then calls a sub-routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12A72
name: set_field_value_and_call
description: Writes a 16-bit field of the record with a value chosen by an index byte, writes a state byte, then calls a sub-routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12A98
name: set_entity_state_defaults
description: Calls a sub-routine, then sets a 16-bit field and state bytes of the record to fixed defaults, switching to alternative values when a flag bit is set.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12ADE
name: link_records_into_chain
description: When either record has a flag bit set, detaches the first record from its list and, for a special mode value, appends it to a chain and initialises its fields. Otherwise it cross-links the two records' pointer fields and sets their state bytes.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12B94
name: cross_link_two_records
description: Stores each record's offset into a pointer field of the other, and sets state bytes on both. When the first record's type byte is not four, it also sets two more bytes in that record.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12BD8
name: initialize_spawn_entry
description: Initialises a record's type and state bytes and a word copied from a global, then calls a sub-routine and, when its result is not positive, calls another. It sets a final state byte and clears a field unless a flag bit makes it return early.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12C3C
name: invoke_four_subroutines_only
description: The decompiled body is unavailable, so only its relationships are known: it calls four other routines and is called by one. Its forty-three instructions are not interpreted further.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12CE2
name: dispatch_record_state_flags
description: Tests a mask of input flags in priority order, and for each recognised flag writes a value into the record, sometimes taken from a global table by index, then calls sub-routines.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12D2C
name: set_record_timing_and_state
description: Writes a fixed 16-bit value and a state byte into the record pointed to by the input register and returns.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12D3A
name: dispatch_partial_state_flags

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12D5C
name: initialize_struct_fields
description: Writes a fixed 16-bit value and four state bytes into the record pointed to by the input register, with no calls.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12D7C
name: dispatch_flags_with_subcalls
description: Checks a mask of input flags and, for each recognised bit, writes a timing word and state bytes into the record. Some values are chosen from a global table by index, sub-routines are called in each branch, and it returns early when a lookup value is zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12DA8
name: dispatch_remaining_state_flags
description: Checks a subset of input flags and writes a timing word and state bytes for each recognised bit, calling sub-routines, with some values taken from a global table. It returns early when a lookup is zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12DDC
name: write_timing_state_then_call
description: Writes a fixed 16-bit value into the record, calls a sub-routine, writes four state bytes through a pointer returned by that call, and calls another sub-routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12DFE
name: set_object_header_fields
description: Writes a 16-bit field of the record with a value chosen by an index byte, calls a sub-routine, then writes four state bytes through the pointer it returns.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12E36
name: dispatch_flags_with_timing_writes
description: Checks a mask of input flags and, for each recognised bit, writes a timing word and state bytes into the record, calling sub-routines and taking some values from a global table. It returns early when a lookup is zero.

description: Walks a linked list for an entry of type four with a matching key byte and sets a flag bit on it, returning one. Without a match it calls a sub-routine and returns one when a global flag bit is clear, and returns zero otherwise.

name: return_zero_constant

name: initialize_record_and_dispatch

description: Walks a table of word entries and, for each entry whose masked bits are clear and whose stored byte equals a given value, writes a fixed value into that byte. It returns the masked bits of the last entry.

description: Steps through a set of 314-byte structures, decrementing a counter in those of type four and reloading it when it runs out. It calls sub-routines for structures of type eighteen.

description: Walks a table of word entries, skipping those whose masked bits are set, until one has a weight byte equal to the input. It then writes a type-four record and decrements a counter, resetting it when it runs out.

description: Checks a flag field in an input structure, decrements a counter and reloads it when it reaches zero, then compares a scaled global value with a value from a second structure. On success it writes two bytes to the output block and returns one; otherwise zero.

name: dispatch_handler_by_index
description: When a global counter exceeds a threshold and a structure field is non-zero, selects a handler from a jump table by an index derived from a sub-routine result modulo a size field. It calls that handler and returns its result, and returns zero otherwise.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13D5C

description: Scans a set of word entries, offsetting each by a start value, and keeps the one closest to a reference value among those whose masked bits and flag bit meet a condition. It returns one when a match was found and zero otherwise.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13DB8
name: find_nearest_flagged_entry
description: Scans a set of word entries and keeps the one closest to a reference value among those whose table flag bit is set. It returns one when such an entry was found and zero otherwise.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13DBE

description: Calls a sub-routine, clamps two returned bytes to the range zero to 63, and stores each in the structure followed by a constant byte. It then calls another sub-routine and returns the input registers.

description: Computes an entry offset from an index byte, writes a pointer and several bytes into a table entry, sets a constant byte, and copies a word from a second table. It then calls a sub-routine.

name: clear_flag_zero_table_entry
description: If bit zero of a flag byte in the record is set, it clears that bit, zeroes a table entry indexed by the record's index byte, and calls a sub-routine. It returns its input register unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:140F0
name: link_record_into_table_slot
description: Selects a table slot from a record's index byte and copies a word from it into the record. When the slot was empty it links the record there, then either sets a timing value and state byte or calls sub-routines, depending on a flag bit.

description: Writes a fixed 16-bit timing value and a state byte into the record, and copies a 16-bit value from a global into a second field.

name: set_record_kind_and_state
description: Writes two state bytes into the record pointed to by the input register and returns.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:141A2

description: Repeatedly tests a record's cost value against a limit while walking a linked list of entries from a given head and updating qualifying entries. It returns zero at the end of the list and a failure code otherwise.

name: dispatch_record_through_table
description: Looks up a word from a table by an index byte, sets a flag bit and state bytes on the record, and dispatches through a jump table.

name: dispatch_record_through_table
description: Looks up a word from a table by an index byte, sets a flag bit and state bytes on the record, and dispatches through a jump table.

name: copy_byte_and_decrement
description: Copies a byte from a source record at a fixed offset into a destination byte, subtracts a constant from it, and returns zero.

name: swap_table_entry
description: When a flag bit is set for the table entry selected by two input bytes, replaces that entry with the value stored at the index the entry holds. It performs no other operations.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1677A
name: build_neighbour_mask_and_mark
description: Unless a flag bit is set, either finds a matching table entry or builds a four-bit mask from neighbouring cells that pass a flag test. It writes the result into the cell, updates a linked entry's timing and state, rewrites neighbouring cells whose mask bit is set, and returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:167BC
name: rewrite_cell_from_neighbour_mask
description: Builds a four-bit neighbour mask from cells that pass a flag test, writes a value derived from it into the cell, updates a linked entry's timing and state, and rewrites neighbouring cells whose mask bit is set. It returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:167DA
name: rewrite_neighbours_from_cell_value
description: Writes the input cell's class byte into a cell, updates a linked entry's timing and state, and rewrites neighbouring cells whose mask bit is set, using a derived value. It returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:167E2
name: rewrite_neighbours_from_mask
description: Builds a four-bit mask from neighbouring cells that pass a flag test, writes a derived class value into the cell, and rewrites neighbouring cells whose mask bit is set. It returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16870
name: update_linked_entry_and_neighbours
description: Finds the first linked entry of kind twenty-six and updates its timing and state, then rewrites neighbouring cells whose mask bit is set, using a derived class value. It returns one.

name: return_one_constant
description: Returns one and performs no other work.

name: scan_weighted_table_entries
description: Computes a start offset from an index and a table, then loops a calculated number of times. Each pass calls a sub-routine, indexes a short table with its result, and marks a global cell when flag checks pass. It returns the last combined value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:169CC
name: compute_and_mark_table_entries
description: Computes an iteration count from a global value and a sub-routine result, then in each pass calls a sub-routine, indexes a short table and marks a global cell with a constant when flag checks pass. It returns the last combined value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16A62
name: mark_entries_when_mask_full
description: Computes a starting value from a table and a sub-routine result, then loops over neighbouring positions, marking a global cell with a fixed byte where a combined mask equals fifteen. It returns the combined value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16AF4
name: fill_free_entry_from_list
description: Walks a sentinel-terminated list of offsets and, for each match whose flag passes a test, fills the first free entry with a kind, a timing value from a table and two scaled values, then calls a sub-routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16B66
name: fill_entries_with_flag_matches
description: Walks a sentinel-terminated offset list and, for each position whose flag bit passes a test, fills the first free entry with a kind, a timing value and two scaled values, then calls a sub-routine. It returns the last combined value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16BF6
name: return_without_work
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16BFC
name: fill_free_entries_from_division
description: Divides a value from a sub-routine into a quotient and remainder, then fills the first free 16-byte entry with masked values, a kind and a timing value. It repeats while a sub-routine reports a non-zero result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16C36
name: fill_entry_from_masked_word
description: Repeatedly calls a sub-routine and builds a masked word from its low bytes and an input word. When the mask is zero it writes several bytes and words into a record, taking one field from a table, then calls another sub-routine and continues while a value remains.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16CC8
name: claim_free_entry_for_value
description: Claims the first free 32-byte entry in a global table, writes two input bytes into it, sets a timing value derived from a table and a kind, and returns one. It returns zero when no entry is free.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16CEA
name: initialize_struct_from_registers
description: Writes two input bytes into the record pointed to by the input register, sets a timing value derived from a table, stores a kind byte, and returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16D2C
name: update_neighbourhood_cells_by_flags
description: Walks a rectangular neighbourhood of cells around the record, calling a sub-routine for each flagged cell and adjusting matching global cells by a fixed amount. It also updates a timing value in the record and returns the combined result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip][a](disk 1 of 2)/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16DD6
name: adjust_cell_block_values
description: Walks a block of cells around the input position, adjusting matching global cells by a fixed amount where a mask bit test passes, and calls sub-routines for flagged neighbours. It returns the combined result.
